# Copilot instructions

Follow the agent workflow defined in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It covers
the primary task in this repository — authoring datasource configuration schema entries under
`schema-registry/<plugin_id>/` — including the research process, file structure, naming
conventions, authoring rules, and the validation checklist. The workflow is datasource-agnostic;
use `schema-registry/grafana-github-datasource/` as the worked reference example.
